'''T3-G2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] as a messenger on [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
